input.summary: Replace Singapore governing law and exclusive Singapore jurisdiction in 28.1 with New York law, relying on 28.2's existing New York County venue.
input.comment: [Playbook] We replaced Singapore law and exclusive Singapore jurisdiction with New York law, our preferred position, which also removes the conflict with the exclusive New York County venue already agreed in 28.2. Delaware, California, or England and Wales law with the corresponding courts would be acceptable fallbacks.

ops.oldText: governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction
ops.newText: governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York
